title: Reverse linked list — iterative

def mk(vs):
    h=t=ListNode(vs[0])
    for v in vs[1:]:t.next=ListNode(v);t=t.next
    return h
def ls(h):
    r=[]
    while h:r.append(h.val);h=h.next
    return r
ls(Solution().reverse(mk([1,2,3,4,5])))
